native_notes.scope: Diagnostic inference/generation only; stored costs counted once across ranking seeds and recovery conditions. No new experiment.
native_notes.missing_policy: Missing source fields are null, never silently zero. A non-generative model's absent token/code fields can be shown as not applicable, with that convention stated explicitly.
native_notes.time_note: Elapsed sums exclude model load/download/pause and shared recovery. GPU differences prevent direct cross-hardware speedup claims. GenPRM seconds and code_seconds are separately recorded; do not add them without checking timing scope.
native_notes.genprm_dev_note: Use genprm_native_cost from repaired V2. original_v1_native_cost and repair_job_native_cost describe development work; do not add them to the corrected full-evaluation cost.
native_notes.ours_note: The lightweight diagnostic's historical complete inference latency was not measured in these cache-reuse runs; it is unreported, not zero.
